old_caption: The video captures a serene and misty forest scene. The camera is positioned on a rocky outcrop, providing a vantage point over a dense forest shrouded in fog. The trees, primarily coniferous, stand tall and partially obscured by the thick mist, creating an ethereal atmosphere. A lone, leafless tree stands to the right, its bare branches reaching upwards against the foggy backdrop. In the foreground, a person's red shoe is visible, suggesting they are sitting or standing nearby, perhaps taking in the tranquil surroundings. The camera remains stationary throughout the sequence, allowing viewers to absorb the peaceful and mysterious ambiance of the forest enveloped in fog.

caption: The video captures a level view of a fog-shrouded mountain ridge. A large grey boulder in the lower-left foreground holds a person's foot in a maroon sneaker with a white sole, which stays still throughout. A thin pinkish grass stalk with forked seed heads rises slightly out of focus at the left, swaying as its top tilts side to side against the mist. The steep mid-ground ridge is densely packed with dark green conifers whose upper crowns gradually dissolve into drifting white fog, partly obscuring the visible tree line. On the right, a mostly bare, gnarled tree with a few green leaves remains largely fixed against a uniformly overcast sky. The lighting stays flat, with no obvious camera pan or zoom.
